# printer-XX.cfg entry-point template

This page documents the common structure of every numbered printer entry point. Each deployed printer keeps its own copy as `printer.cfg`; it is not a shared fleet file.

[All files](README.md) · [Reading guide](READING_GUIDE.md)

## Common structure

- Include `machine.cfg`, which owns the shared hardware and macro configuration.
- Declare `[mcu]` and `[mcu extra_mcu]` with that printer’s USB serial identities.
- Retain Klipper’s generated `SAVE_CONFIG` block for machine-specific Eddy calibration, PID values, input shaping, bed meshes, and other saved calibration.

The active section layout is checked across all numbered entry points whenever this page is generated. Values and generated calibration are intentionally allowed to differ.
